item.name: Starter Rod
item.notes: Base rod with no Luck or Speed bonus.
item.cardSummary: The free starter rod every player begins with. Replace it quickly once you can buy a shop upgrade or claim the free Lava Rod.

item.name: Luck Rod
item.notes: Cheapest paid Luck upgrade for new players.
item.cardSummary: A $250 shop rod that adds early Luck. Useful only until free Lava or stronger Uncommon rods are available.

item.name: Carbon Rod
item.notes: Slightly faster Common option with modest Luck.
item.cardSummary: A $900 Common shop rod with a bit more Speed than the Luck Rod. Still an early-game stopgap before Uncommon gear.

item.name: Toy Rod
item.howToGet: Like the game and join the Fish Atelier group
item.notes: Free social reward; no coin cost.
item.cardSummary: A free Common rod earned by liking the experience and joining the Fish Atelier Roblox group. Better than the bare starter, then replace it as you earn coins.

item.name: Lava Rod
item.howToGet: Talk to the Lava Fisherman NPC
item.notes: Best free early upgrade for most new players.
item.cardSummary: Free Uncommon rod from the Lava Fisherman inside Kohana Volcano. Strong early weight for a no-cost pickup before you farm for shop rods.

item.name: Grass Rod
item.cardSummary: A $1,500 Uncommon shop rod with solid early Luck and a 250 kg weight cap for heavier beginner fish.

item.name: Damascus Rod
item.notes: Also listed as Demascus Rod in some guides.
item.cardSummary: A $3,000 Uncommon shop rod with the highest early Luck in its tier. Slow Speed, so it is mainly a Luck step before Rare rods.

item.name: Ice Rod
item.notes: Highest Uncommon weight for heavy early fish.
item.cardSummary: A $5,000 Uncommon shop rod built around weight capacity. Good when you need to land heavier fish before Rare upgrades.

item.name: Lucky Rod
item.notes: Common early-money grind pick after Lava Rod.
item.cardSummary: A $10,000 Rare shop rod with a big Luck jump for its stage. A standard early-to-mid farming upgrade after free Lava progress.

item.name: Midnight Rod
item.notes: More weight and Speed than Lucky Rod, less Luck.
item.cardSummary: A $50,000 Rare shop rod that trades some Luck for higher Speed and a 10,000 kg weight cap. Useful when heavier fish matter more than raw Luck.

item.name: Steampunk Rod
item.cardSummary: A $215,000 Epic mid-game shop rod with balanced Luck and Speed for coin farming before Legendary options.

item.name: Chrome Rod
item.notes: Strong mid-game weight for heavy rare fish.
item.cardSummary: A $437,000 Epic shop rod with high Luck and a large weight limit. A common mid-game purchase before Legendary merchant and shop rods.

item.name: Fluorescent Rod
item.notes: Cheapest Legendary by coin price; relatively slow Speed.
item.cardSummary: A $715,000 Legendary rod sold in shops or by the Traveling Merchant. Strong Luck for its price, but slower than other Legendaries.

item.name: Astral Rod
item.notes: Has been nerfed across updates; treat as a mid-late step, not endgame.
item.cardSummary: A $1,000,000 Legendary shop rod with high Speed for its tier. Often used as a temporary step toward Hazmat, Ares, or quest rods.

item.name: Hazmat Rod
item.notes: Stock rotates; check the merchant when it visits.
item.cardSummary: A $1,300,000 Legendary rod from the Traveling Merchant with top Legendary Luck and 300,000 kg weight. A key mid-to-late grind stick before Mythic and Secret rods.

item.name: Ghostfinn Rod
item.notes: Quest tasks: catch 300 Rare/Epic fish in the Treasure Room, catch 3 Mythic and 1 Secret at Sisyphus Statue, and earn 1M coins.
item.cardSummary: Free Mythic quest rod from the Deep Sea Quest on Lost Isle. High Luck, very high Speed, and enough weight for late-game rarities without a huge coin buy-in.

item.name: Ares Rod
item.notes: Cheapest Mythic shop rod; often outclassed by Ghostfinn for pure value.
item.cardSummary: A $3,000,000 Mythic rod sold at Tropical Grove. Solid all-around stats, but Ghostfinn usually offers better free value for the same progression stage.

item.name: Angler Rod
item.cardSummary: An $8,000,000 Mythic rod from Lost Isle with strong Luck and Speed. A paid alternative when you want shop progress without finishing the Ghostfinn quest yet.

item.name: Bamboo Rod
item.notes: Highest Luck among standard paid Mythic shop rods.
item.cardSummary: A $12,000,000 Mythic rod from Ancient Jungle’s Sacred Temple area. Top shop Luck before the free Element and Diamond quest rods.

item.name: Element Rod
item.notes: Requires Ghostfinn Rod in major guides. Tasks include catching Secrets in Ancient Jungle and Sacred Temple, then creating 3 Transcended Stones.
item.cardSummary: Secret quest rod with 1111% Luck and 130% Speed. Unlocked after the Element Quest chain in Ancient Jungle and used as the bridge into Diamond.

item.name: Diamond Rod
item.notes: Requires Element Rod in major guides. Tasks include Secrets at Coral Reefs and Tropical Grove, delivering special fish/items to Larry, and 1,000 perfect throws.
item.cardSummary: Current top Secret rod with 1300% Luck, 167% Speed, and a 1,000,000 kg weight cap. Earned from the Diamond Researcher after the Element path.

item.name: Angelic Rod
item.notes: Premium purchase; generally weaker than late F2P Mythic and Secret rods.
item.cardSummary: A 399 Robux gamepass rod with mid-tier stats. Optional paid shortcut that free progression rods eventually outclass.

item.name: Gold Rod
item.notes: Low stats for the Robux cost compared with free shop progression.
item.cardSummary: A 445 Robux gamepass rod with modest Luck and low weight. Skip for most players who can buy or earn in-game rods instead.

item.name: Hyper Rod
item.notes: Most expensive gamepass rod; still far below Mythic and Secret F2P options.
item.cardSummary: A 999 Robux gamepass rod with Rare-range Luck. Not worth the cost once shop and quest rods are in reach.
